notes.title: Capture moments with the Forgers in SPYxANYA: Operation Memories, now available!
notes.content:
Create and cherish joyful memories with the Forger Family!

Tasked with making a photo diary as an assignment for Eden College, players must take memorable pictures of Anya to complete her diary from the series through fun family outings to the park, beach, dog park, aquarium, and museum.

SPYxANYA: Operation Memories also includes a variety of more than 15 mini-games based on familiar scenes from the anime - ranging from peanut-themed bowling to rhythm training with Yor. Players can earn points from mini-games and unlock over 80 unique costumes and outing items, including clothing, accessories, and hairstyles for Anya, Loid, Yor, and Bond.

[previewyoutube=8VCz8QyOcfc;full][/previewyoutube]
 SPYxANYA: Operation Memories is now available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2170370/SPYANYA_Operation_Memories/

notes.title: Join in on the Forger fun with SPYxANYA: Operation Memories!
notes.content:
The first console-game of “SPY×FAMILY” will be available on June 28! Play as Anya to experience the world of SPY×FAMILY.

Anya Forger has a new assignment from school: create a photo diary! On weekdays, go to school, then visit all sorts of exciting places like the beach or aquarium in search of subjects to photograph on weekends.

[previewyoutube=kQceBmmeHlU;full][/previewyoutube]
There are more than 80 types of clothes, accessories, and hairstyles! Let's dress up and go out in your style.

More than 15 mini-games of various types that allow you to experience the unique daily life in the "SPY×FAMILY" style are included. Anya's telepathy may even allow her to read her opponent's hand of cards!

Enjoy the precious time with family and friends across various places including the school and home.

Will Anya be able to complete her picture diary?

Stay tuned for further information and wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2170370/SPYANYA_Operation_Memories/?curator_clanid=33042543
